_about: ASSET-003 Gorgemaw kitbash: every add-on is a vanilla mesh (Hive lumps with our per-vertex offsets) on one Lox bone (or skinned, see mode). For each part: create an ANCHOR as a child of `parent` with localPosition/localRotation/localScale (Runic armor_attach convention: localScale 1/BSCALE cancels the Lox's bone-chain scale, localRotation undoes the bone's REST rotation, so the anchor is world-aligned in the rest pose), then a child carrying the vanilla mesh with `part_localRotation` / `part_localScale` (Unity axes) at position 0. Units: Unity, the Lox prefab's REST pose.
